avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 4 to 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: June 12 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Beaver Pass

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and the lowest at Marten Ridge (3,520 ft) and Beaver Pass (3,630 ft).

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 7 and July 7, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
